description: Traces execution flows through the graph from discovered entry points. Forward tracing walks the call graph with noise filtering. Reverse tracing produces multiple paths converging on a target. Convergence detection counts nodes appearing in multiple flows.
label: Flow Tracing

members.note: Forward DFS walk. Noise filter excludes utility/helper nodes below a configurable call threshold.
Backward walk from a target node. Produces multiple Branch paths.
Counts nodes that appear in multiple traced flows. High convergence indicates shared infrastructure.
Classifies nodes as route/component/export/handler based on kind, export status, and naming conventions.
A named flow: entry point + ordered list of node IDs + branches.
Client-side reactive state: view mode, entry points, active flows, convergence data.
Scopes the graph to flow-relevant nodes and re-runs computeView.
